title: HistoryEvidence
description: Bounded provenance and outcome evidence for one history item.

agent_id.description: Public agent identity, or an explicit unavailable marker.

created_at.description: RFC3339 UTC creation time, never inferred from list order.

platform_id.description: Public platform identity, never a host path or hostname.

provider_source.description: Public provider source/profile identity, never a credential.

result_integrity.description: Whether all required result evidence is intact.

unavailable_reasons.description: Explicit reason codes for unavailable fields/evidence.

DurableOutcome.description: Durable public outcome used by the history extension.

oneOf.description: Execution or evidence collection failed durably.
Cancellation reached a durable terminal state.
Outcome is unavailable and must not be rendered as success or zero.

ResultIntegrity.description: Result-integrity state exposed by the history extension.

oneOf.description: All required public result records are verified.
Evidence was present but failed integrity checks.
The settings shape or syntax is invalid.
A referenced immutable component cannot be verified.
A configured resource bound is invalid.
